annotations.text:
THESE ARE NOT FINISHED. READ THIS FIRST.

Three screens have had a craft pass — Card reveal, Recording, Money moment. They set the bar: ambient glow, film grain, gradient type, elevation with inner top-highlight, real avatars, refined micro-typography.

The other seven are WIREFRAMES wearing the palette. Correct structure, correct content, no craft. They are below the reference examples and must not go in front of a judge as they are.

Refinement brief: 04_assets/mockups/REFINEMENT_BRIEF.md

WHAT THE CRAFT PASS ADDED (copy this to the other seven)

1. Radial ambient glow behind the focal element — the single biggest win
2. SVG film grain at 0.5 opacity, overlay blend — makes flat dark UI feel like material
3. Inner top highlight on every raised surface: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(250,246,241,0.07). THIS is what separates expensive dark UI from amateur
4. Real elevation: 0 20px 44px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.9)
5. Gradient-filled display type with a soft glow, not flat white
6. Tighter display tracking (-0.035em) and a wider size gap between levels
7. Avatars with initials — even simple ones read as a real product

CARD CONTENT UPDATED 31 AUG 2026.

SEFOFANE (Main.dc.html) is real: sw-001 in cards_setswana.json, native-confirmed by Lethabo, identical target and blocked words. KGOMO (Listen/Receipt/Referee) replaces an old placeholder — isithuthuthu — that was never reviewed and, worse, carried a Nguni isi- prefix on a screen labelled Setswana. kgomo is sw-002, also native-confirmed. If isiZulu content is ever needed on a screen, pull one of Sbu's eight from cards_isizulu.json — never re-guess a word.

RULES THAT SURVIVE ANY REDESIGN

• MTN yellow appears ONLY where value moves. Nothing decorative is yellow.
• A missed guess is ochre, never red. Not being understood is information, not an error.
• Money screens stay boring — no gradient, tabular numerals, never says 'paid' before MoMo confirms.
• Two listeners, not three. Everywhere.
• The LISTENER referees the banned-word rule, never the speaker.
• No fake status bar — the real one renders on top.
• League is cut per the kill rules (05_BUILD.md §6) — deliberately not on this canvas.
